technical.summary: Short-term momentum signals (EMA9/21 cross, Stoch cross) show bullish confluence, but weak trend strength (ADX 17), price below key MAs (50/200), and Ichimoku cloud resistance limit conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: AMD shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 68 days—insufficient smart money alignment for a bullish thesis.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (10/10) and bearish AAII sentiment (53.5%) create contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional activity and absent news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds with VIX in crisis territory (372.16), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, and earnings event 68 days away create a highly unfavourable risk environment for AMD.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum confluence (EMA9/21 golden cross, Stoch bullish cross, MACD crossover up) with extreme fear sentiment (10/10) and contrarian buy signal creates a tactical entry opportunity near support at 90.15.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis at 372.16, flat yield curve recession risk), price below both 50-SMA and 200-EMA, weak ADX trend strength (17), Ichimoku cloud resistance, no fundamental conviction (score 3), and high earnings risk within 68 days make this a high-risk entry in an unfavourable environment.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum signals (EMA9/21 cross, Stoch cross) offer tactical confluence, but severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve) and price below 50/200-SMA create asymmetric risk that outweighs contrarian opportunity.
decision.primary_risk: VIX in crisis territory (372.16) combined with earnings event 68 days away and price below intermediate resistance (50-SMA) creates elevated drawdown risk in unfavourable macro environment.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — technical shows moderate bullish signals but fundamental, sentiment, and risk agents all align on unfavourable conditions; bear case dominates debate with high confidence
decision.portfolio_note: Already 5 positions in Information Technology sector; adding AMD would increase concentration risk in high-volatility sector during macro stress.
